description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericEnumListConverter' that implements the 'AttributeConverter' interface to facilitate conversion between a list of enum values and their comma-separated string representation for database storage. It provides generic handling for enum lists, including optional deduplication.

classes.name: GenericEnumListConverter
classes.description: An abstract generic class that converts between a list of enum constants and a comma-separated string for persistence, supporting optional uniqueness of enum values.

methods.name: isUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the list should be treated as a set with unique elements.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts a list of enum values to a comma-separated string for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string from the database back into a list of enum values.
